newsitem.title: UK: Tennis-Former champion Cash qualifies for Wimbledon.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Former champion Cash qualifies for Wimbledon.

text.p: Former Wimbledon champion Pat Cash of Australia successfully fought his way through qualifying on Saturday to secure his place in this year's main draw.
Cash, who beat Ivan Lendl in straight sets to win the 1987 title, defeated Israel's Oren Motevassel to earn a first round encounter with Zimbabwe's Byron Black.

The Australian received a wildcard into the qualifying tournament at Roehampton and won all three of his matches, finishing with a 4-6 6-3 6-4 win over Motevassel which had been interrupted by rain at one-set all on Friday.
